//: Type-aware linting only — never used to build. `tsconfig.json` excludes `*.test.ts` and includes only `src/`, so it would leave the integration suite in `test/` and both Vitest configs outside every TypeScript project. typescript-eslint's project service could then not parse them and lint would fail with a parsing error instead of reporting anything. This project exists only to give the linter a program that covers the tests and `vitest.config.ts`.
